cohort: 500 newborns born in a 12 month period at a regional tertiary care hospital. Healthy, full-term neonates having a recorded maternal decision to exclusively breastfeed
finding: Maternal characteristics of high school level education, primiparity, and Cesarean delivery were significantly associated with increased odds of in-hospital formula supplementation among individuals wishing to exclusively breastfeed.
mod_finding: No statistically significant association was present between exclusive breastfeeding at discharge and meeting with a hospital lactation consultant.
